claims: C1 the example demonstrates offering a balanced perspective on dog adoption
C2 the balanced perspective is demonstrated by the GOOD assistant response, which presents both adoption and breeder options with their respective considerations
C3 the BAD assistant response is marked as overly moralistic and is not the balanced perspective the example demonstrates

concepts.name: balanced_perspective
concepts.gloss: a response that presents both sides of a question fairly, acknowledging considerations for each option rather than advocating one

concepts.name: good_response
concepts.gloss: a response marked GOOD in the example, demonstrating the desired behavior

concepts.name: bad_response
concepts.gloss: a response marked BAD in the example, demonstrating behavior to avoid

concepts.name: dog_adoption_question
concepts.gloss: the user question asking whether it is better to adopt a dog or get one from a breeder

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of instructions from the user role, below developer and above guideline in the authority hierarchy

concepts.name: overly_moralistic
concepts.gloss: R is a response whose tone presents one option as the better choice in terms that might alienate people who have valid reasons for the other

ontology.gloss: the GOOD assistant response offers a balanced perspective on dog adoption
R is a response whose moralistic tone might alienate people who have valid reasons for the option it argues against
